title: SkyReels V2 launches unlimited length AI video #SkyReelsV2 #AIvideoGeneration #OpenSourceAI
description: SkyReels V2 released an open source AI video model capable of generating unlimited length videos, surpassing the usual 15-second limit. Developed by SkyWork AI, it uses diffusion forcing to continuously extend videos without stitching clips together, maintaining coherent visual flow. The model accepts text prompts or reference images, delivering visual quality comparable to premium tools like Kling and Runway. Users can run SkyReels V2 locally on high-end GPUs like the RTX 4090 or access it via the official website with free credits, making advanced AI video generation more accessible. This innovation marks a significant step in the AI video generation market, offering unlimited video length and open source availability that can drive new creative and practical applications across media production, advertising, and entertainment. #SkyReelsV2 #SkyWorkAI #AIVideoGeneration #DiffusionForcing #OpenSourceAI #HuggingFace #RTX4090 #KlingAI #RunwayML #AIInnovation #VideoTech #MachineLearning #GenerativeAI #AIModels #TechInnovation
